obligations.name: bind_session_stream
obligations.description: Execute every coordination mutation against one AgentIDE session Eventlog stream.

obligations.name: authorize_session_owner
obligations.description: Admit only the verified owner or a currently authorized delegated executor.

obligations.name: authorize_requested_session_scopes
obligations.description: Refuse a session whose requested delegation scopes exceed verified authority.

obligations.name: require_active_session
obligations.description: Refuse state-changing operations after session close.

obligations.name: partition_session_projection
obligations.description: Partition session projections by authenticated tenant, exact realm, owner and scopes.

obligations.name: validate_grantee_partition
obligations.description: Admit grants only for a subject resolved inside the same authenticated partition.

obligations.name: nested_grant
obligations.description: Resolve a grant only inside its parent coding-session stream.

obligations.name: nested_context_pin
obligations.description: Resolve a context pin only inside its parent coding-session stream.

obligations.name: nested_approval_checkpoint
obligations.description: Resolve an approval checkpoint only inside its parent coding-session stream.

obligations.name: inherit_grant_authority
obligations.description: Derive grant visibility from the session; callers cannot supply owner or scope.

obligations.name: inherit_context_pin_authority
obligations.description: Derive context-pin visibility from the session; callers cannot supply owner or scope.

obligations.name: inherit_checkpoint_authority
obligations.description: Derive checkpoint visibility from the session; callers cannot supply owner or scope.

obligations.name: hide_closed_session_children
obligations.description: Hide child coordination projections once their session is closed.

obligations.name: filter_visible_sessions
obligations.description: Filter every session query with current verified authority.

behavior.reason: decided outside the system: durable state is unavailable
behavior.contract: given `agentide.coordination.ApproveCheckpoint` input, decide and enact exactly one outcome — `approved` otherwise, takes `approve` of `agentide.coordination.ApprovalCheckpoint`, emits `agentide.coordination.ApprovalCheckpointApproved`; `wrong-state` from a state no declared move starts in, error `agentide.coordination.CoordinationStateConflict`; `refused` externally decided (durable state is unavailable), error `agentide.coordination.CoordinationRefusal`

behavior.reason: decided outside the system: durable state cannot be updated
behavior.contract: given `agentide.session.CloseSession` input, decide and enact exactly one outcome — `closed` otherwise, takes `close` of `agentide.session.CodingSession`, emits `agentide.session.SessionClosed`; `wrong-state` from a state no declared move starts in, error `agentide.session.SessionStateConflict`; `refused` externally decided (durable state cannot be updated), error `agentide.session.SessionRefusal`

behavior.reason: decided outside the system: authority or durable state is unavailable
behavior.contract: given `agentide.coordination.CreateGrant` input, decide and enact exactly one outcome — `created` otherwise, creates `agentide.coordination.AuthorityGrant`, emits `agentide.coordination.GrantCreated`; `refused` externally decided (authority or durable state is unavailable), error `agentide.coordination.CoordinationRefusal`
